simple_flow.content: Low-sun hero, sampling macro, LED work patch, studio diagnostic, or other prepared shot.
simple_flow.behavior: Show actual availability and the specific unresolved source or executor requirement.

simple_flow.label: Choose quality
simple_flow.content: Preview, Portfolio or Lunar Master, resolved through the existing quality presets.
simple_flow.behavior: Show supported output size and quality budget; preserve camera and appearance locks.

simple_flow.label: Render
simple_flow.content: Preflight summary, progress, cancel, and raw/finished result comparison.
simple_flow.behavior: Resolve the complete request before one atomic scene apply; never silently drop optical features.

advanced_groups: physical material vs appearance vs simulation
camera, clipping and depth of field
controls.selection_policy: Contextual controls show the selected body, face or supported occurrence scope; shared component edits explain their scope before applying.

availability_states.action: View required model and source record

defaults.earth_and_stars: Off until a separately reviewed site/time/exposure binding enables them.
defaults.unsupported_feature: Block the affected shot and name the missing capability.
defaults.preview_fallback: Explicit opt-in, with an approximation badge retained in the saved request.

accessibility: Keyboard navigation through search, scene cards, controls and preflight.
Text labels in addition to thumbnails and status colors.
Screen-reader descriptions of capability and source blockers.
Numeric controls with units, typed entry, undo and reset.
Reduced-motion mode for turntable and progress previews.
integration_rules: Use the existing command registry for user-visible behavior.
Use theme::Tokens and approved UI icon assignments.
Use navigation::handle for the render camera.
Keep resource resolution and validation in the engine, not duplicated UI logic.
Catalog JSON describes intent; it does not register production commands.
acceptance: A first-time user can find a prepared scene, understand any blocker and choose supported quality without opening Advanced.
An expert can reproduce every applied value and source hash.
Cancel, failure and unsupported requests preserve the document.
Appearance edits never change density, inertia, friction or joint limits.
